# Tested language examples

These examples are compiled and exercised by the language contract tests. The snippets below come directly from the tested source files.

## Effect binding and return

Execute an effect, bind its result, and return a computed value.

```funscript
import { Effect } from "effect"

export program = effect {
  value <- Effect.succeed(2)
  => value + 1
}
```

## Numeric comparison

Combine numeric comparisons with short-circuit conjunction.

```funscript
export inRange = (value: Number) => value >= 0 and value < 10
```
